actions.script:
const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.projects.TimeServices.get#TimesheetDetail').parameters({timesheetId: timesheetId || '', appRoot: appRoot || null}).call() || {} ec.message.clearErrors() const L = (text) => ec.l10n.localize(text) const enc = (text) => String(text == null ? '' : text).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(//g, '>').replace(/"/g, '"') printUrl = '/apps/' + (appRoot === 'People' ? 'People' : 'Projects') + '/Time/TimesheetPrint?renderMode=html-print×heetId=' + encodeURIComponent(timesheetId || '') const sheet = out.detail if (!sheet) { printHtml = '

' + enc(L('This timesheet is not available')) + '

'; return } const row = (label, value) => value ? '' + enc(L(label)) + '' + enc(value) + '' : '' const table = (heads, rows) => rows.length ? '' + heads.map((head) => '').join('') + '' + rows.map((cells) => '' + cells.map((cell) => '').join('') + '').join('') + '
' + enc(L(head)) + '
' + enc(cell) + '
' : '

' + enc(L('None')) + '

' const title = (text) => '
' + enc(L(text)) + '
' const state = sheet.returned ? L('Returned') + (sheet.reason ? ': ' + sheet.reason : '') : sheet.statusId === 'TmshApproved' ? L('Approved') + (sheet.approvedByName ? ' ' + L('by') + ' ' + sheet.approvedByName : '') + (sheet.approvedText ? ' · ' + sheet.approvedText : '') : sheet.statusId === 'TmshCompleted' ? L('Submitted') + (sheet.submittedText ? ' ' + sheet.submittedText : '') : L('Open') // the entries by day: a day's row with its total, then its entries const entryRows = Array.from(sheet.entryRows || []).map((one) => one.isDay ? [one.dayText + (one.holiday ? ' · ' + one.holiday : ''), '', '', '', one.hoursText, '', '', ''] : ['', one.fromText + '–' + one.thruText, (one.workEffortId ? one.workEffortId + ' ' : '') + one.workEffortName, one.projectName, one.hoursText, one.workTypeLabel, one.billableText, one.comments]) printHtml = '
' + enc(sheet.personName) + ' · ' + enc(sheet.weekText) + '
' + '

' + enc([L('Timesheet'), ec.l10n.format(ec.user.nowTimestamp, 'MMMM d, yyyy')].join(' · ')) + '

' + '' + row('Status', state) + row('Hours', sheet.hoursText) + row('Billable', sheet.billableText) + row('Working hours', sheet.expectedText) + row('Difference', sheet.differenceText) + '
' + title('Entries by day') + table(['Day', 'From–to', 'Work item', 'Project', 'Hours', 'Work type', 'Billable', 'Comment'], entryRows) + title('By project') + table(['Project', 'Work item', 'Hours', 'Billable'], Array.from(sheet.byProject || []).map((line) => [line.projectName || L('No project'), line.workEffortId ? line.workEffortId + ' ' + (line.workEffortName || '') : L('No work item'), line.hoursText, line.billableText])) + title('Flags') + table(['Flag', 'Day'], Array.from(sheet.flagList || []).map((flag) => [flag.text || flag.label || flag.kind, flag.dayText])) + '' + '
' + enc(L('Signed')) + '______________________________' + enc(L('Approved')) + '______________________________
'

render-mode.text: ${JSON.stringify({t: "link", id: "TimesheetPrint", text: ec.l10n.localize("Open the printable timesheet"), url: printUrl})}
